name: Net Friction & Tax Hurdle
known_limitations: Lite has no scorecard or friction runtime; V1 selected policy values are historical contract, not current rate certification.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. Unresolved hurdle/friction config, missing candidate or incumbent score, or missing required economic/friction inputs => INSUFFICIENT_DATA and no eligibility.

details.purpose: Admit exact incumbent replacement only when score and net economic hurdles are met.

pass_condition.description: Outside ROTATE_IN: not applicable PASS only for this gate. ROTATE_IN: candidate raw score minus comparison holding score >= 1.00 and expected incremental return minus modeled switching friction > 0.00 under selected V1 policy.

fail_condition.description: ROTATE_IN score advantage < 1.00 or net economic benefit <= 0.00.

details.score_interaction: Consumes candidate and incumbent canonical scorecards; comparison never modifies raw Decision Score. High score cannot override FAIL.
details.strategy_interaction: ROTATE_IN context only; no strategy verdict or order.
details.portfolio_context: Requires exact comparison holding/rotation context and modeled switching friction; V2 exact parcel economics are not V1.
